description: Work out each sales rep's commission for a period under the plan you send. Send the plan (quota, tiers by percent of quota with a commission rate each, marginal or retroactive tiers, an optional cap per rep) and each rep's code, credited sales, optional own quota and any clawback to recover. Get back, per rep, attainment, the tier reached, the commission per tier, the commission before and after the cap, the clawback recovered, the net payable and any clawback left over, with totals for the team. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/commission-calculator). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

cap.description: Optional: most commission one rep can earn in the period, before clawbacks.

label.description: Optional label for the run, e.g. 'Q1 2026 West' (your own text, echoed).

method.description: marginal (default): each slice of sales earns its own tier's rate. retroactive: all sales earn the rate of the highest tier reached.

quota.description: Plan quota for the period (used for every rep that has no quota of their own).

reps.description: Reps (up to 200), each with a rep code and credited sales for the period.

clawback.description: Optional: commission to recover this period (for example on a deal paid earlier and since cancelled), as a positive amount.

quota.description: Optional: this rep's own quota for the period (overrides the plan quota).

rep.description: Your code for the rep, e.g. 'R-104' or 'WEST-3'. Not the person's name.

sales.description: Credited sales (or bookings, or margin: whatever your plan pays on) for the period, after returns.

tiers.description: Commission tiers (1 to 10), lowest first; the first starts at 0 percent of quota.

from_percent.description: Tier starts at this percent of quota (0 for the first tier; 100 = at quota).

rate_percent.description: Commission rate in this tier, percent of credited sales (an accelerator is a higher rate above quota).
